On VTES-L, VampC...@AOL.COM wrote:
> Can the superior version of Form of Mist be used to end
> combat, even if there is no [action] to continue (for
> example, during a successful Bum's rush combat)?

Yes. The action continues. Since the Bum's Rush was already
in the "successful resolution" stage, you would continue
from that point (typically meaning the end of the action,
although some post-resolution effects could be played.
The acting vampire could play Freak Drive, for example.)
